metod: joint-driven fk sweep; AABB clearance (disjoint -> mesh-disjoint, fail-closed); non-adjacent pairs + arm against static bodies; edge poses at the joint limits; every overlap escalated to an exact OBB/SAT test.
adjacenskriterium: non-adjacent = |i-j|>=2 (neighbouring links share a joint, skipped)
note: AABB-disjoint across the whole sweep proves mesh clearance (the box contains the body). Candidates, if any, must be escalated to an exact test before a verdict.
